fields.label: Sender Role
fields.description: Auto-detected from the thread's driver/passenger fields if not set explicitly.

fields.label: Type
fields.options:
text
image
audio
file
location
system
fields.description: Message classification — drives bubble rendering on the client.

fields.label: Sent At
fields.description: When the server accepted the message.

fields.label: Delivery
fields.description: Per-message lifecycle: sent → delivered (recipient socket connected after the send) → read (recipient opened the thread).

fields.label: Delivered At
fields.description: Stamped when the recipient's session received the realtime payload (or on first thread fetch after the send).

fields.label: Read At
fields.description: Stamped when the recipient explicitly opens the thread containing this message.

fields.label: System Message
fields.description: Auto-generated by the platform (e.g. booking confirmed, trip started).

fields.label: Attachment
fields.description: File URL — public for image / file types, can be private for audio.

fields.label: Attachment Metadata
fields.description: Per-type metadata: {width,height,mime} for image; {duration_seconds,mime} for audio; {filename,mime,size} for file; {lat,lng,label} for location.
